name: Palak Paneer

ingredients.name: Spinach
ingredients.description: Rich in iron and vitamins, provides a vibrant green color.

ingredients.name: Paneer
ingredients.description: A good source of protein and calcium.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Adds sweetness and depth to the dish.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.description: Enhances flavor with its pungent aroma.

ingredients.name: Garam Masala
ingredients.description: A blend of spices for warmth and complexity.

ingredients.name: Oil

instructions: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, then immediately transfer to ice water to retain color.
Drain the spinach and blend it into a smooth puree.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions, garlic, ginger, and green chilli. Sauté until onions are golden brown.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Stir in turmeric powder, garam masala, and salt.
Add the spinach puree and cook for 5 minutes on medium heat.
Add paneer cubes and simmer for another 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Serve hot.

ingredients.name: Cauliflower
ingredients.description: Rich in vitamins C and K, and a good source of fiber.

ingredients.name: Green Peas
ingredients.description: High in protein and fiber, providing essential nutrients.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Adds sweetness and depth of flavor.

instructions: Chop the cauliflower into small florets and rinse them thoroughly.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and add cumin seeds. Let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger and garlic, sauté for another minute until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Stir in turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Mix well.
Add cauliflower florets and green peas. Stir to coat them with the spices.
Cover and cook on low heat for 10-15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Dal Palak

ingredients.name: Toor Dal
ingredients.description: Rich in protein and fiber, essential for a balanced diet.

ingredients.name: Spinach
ingredients.description: High in iron and vitamins, adds a fresh taste.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Adds sweetness and depth to the dish.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.description: Enhances flavor with a pungent taste.

instructions: Rinse the toor dal thoroughly and soak it in water for 15 minutes.
In a pressure cooker, add the soaked dal, 300 ml of water, turmeric powder, and salt. Cook for 3-4 whistles until the dal is soft.
In a pan, heat ghee and add cumin seeds. Once they splutter, add chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and green chilli. Sauté until onions are golden brown.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Add the spinach and cook until it wilts.
Mix the cooked dal into the pan with the spinach mixture. Simmer for 5-7 minutes, adjusting salt as needed.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Tofu Bhurji

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.description: Rich in protein and a great meat substitute.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Adds sweetness and depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.description: Used for sautéing, adds healthy fats.

instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Add minced garlic, ginger, and green chili; sauté for a minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Stir in turmeric, coriander powder, and salt.
Add crumbled tofu and green bell pepper; mix well.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.

name: Bharwan Shimla Mirch

ingredients.name: Bell Pepper
ingredients.description: Rich in vitamins A and C, adds a sweet flavor.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.description: Provides a creamy texture and is a good source of carbohydrates.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.description: Used for cooking and adds richness.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Boil the potatoes until tender, then peel and mash them.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions, ginger, and garlic, sauté until golden brown.
Add green peas, mashed potatoes, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove the seeds.
Stuff the peppers with the potato mixture and place them in a baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the peppers are tender.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves before serving.

ingredients.name: Ridge Gourd
ingredients.description: Low in calories and high in dietary fiber.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Adds sweetness and depth to the dish.

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.description: Rich in vitamin C and adds tanginess.

ingredients.name: Turmeric Powder
ingredients.description: Adds color and has anti-inflammatory properties.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.description: Used for cooking and adds richness.

ingredients.name: Coriander Leaves
ingredients.description: Used for garnish and adds freshness.

instructions: Peel and chop the ridge gourd into small pieces.
Finely chop the onion, tomato, ginger, and garlic.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Add ginger, garlic, and green chili. Sauté for a minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Stir in turmeric powder, coriander powder, and salt.
Add the chopped ridge gourd and mix well.
Cover and cook on low heat until the ridge gourd is tender.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Bhindi Sabji

ingredients.name: Okra
ingredients.description: Rich in fiber and vitamins, helps in digestion.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Adds sweetness and depth to the dish.

ingredients.name: Turmeric Powder
ingredients.description: Adds color and has anti-inflammatory properties.

instructions: Wash and dry the okra thoroughly. Cut into 1-inch pieces.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger, garlic, and green chilli. Sauté for another minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, and salt. Mix well.
Add the okra and stir to coat with the spices.
Cover and cook on low heat for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the okra is tender.
Serve hot.

ingredients.name: Toor Dal

instructions: Rinse the toor dal thoroughly and soak it in water for 15 minutes.
In a pressure cooker, add the soaked dal, turmeric powder, and 400 ml of water. Cook for 3-4 whistles until the dal is soft.
In a pan, heat ghee and add cumin seeds. Once they splutter, add chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and green chilli. Sauté until onions are golden brown.

Mix the cooked dal into the pan, add salt, and simmer for 5-7 minutes to blend flavors.

name: Egg Bhurji

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Add ginger and garlic, sauté for a minute.
Add chopped tomatoes, green chilli, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes are soft.
Beat the eggs in a bowl and pour into the pan.
Stir continuously until the eggs are cooked and scrambled.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

ingredients.name: Coconut

instructions: Wash and slit the baby eggplants, keeping the stems intact.
Dry roast peanuts, coconut, coriander seeds, and cumin seeds until aromatic. Cool and grind to a coarse powder.
Mix the ground powder with chopped onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, red chili powder, tamarind, jaggery, and salt to form a stuffing.
Stuff the eggplants with the prepared mixture.
Heat oil in a pan, add the stuffed eggplants, and cook on low heat, covered, until tender, about 20 minutes.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves before serving.

name: Dal Tadka

ingredients.name: Toor Dal
ingredients.description: Rich in protein and fiber, essential for a balanced diet.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Adds sweetness and depth to the dish.

instructions: Rinse the toor dal thoroughly under running water.
In a pressure cooker, add the rinsed dal and 500 ml of water. Cook for 3-4 whistles until the dal is soft.
In a pan, heat ghee and add cumin seeds and mustard seeds. Let them splutter.
Add chopped onions, ginger, garlic, and green chilli. Sauté until onions are golden brown.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they are soft.
Add turmeric powder and salt. Mix well.
Pour the cooked dal into the pan and mix thoroughly. Let it simmer for 5-10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves before serving.

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a pan and add curry leaves, chopped onions, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until onions are translucent.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric powder, and red chilli powder. Cook until tomatoes are soft.
Add coconut milk and tamarind paste, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the fish pieces and green chilli. Cook for 10-12 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and adjust the consistency with water if needed. Simmer for another 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh curry leaves.

In a pot, add the soaked chana dal with 2 cups of water and a pinch of turmeric. Cook until the dal is soft.
In a separate pan, heat oil and add cumin seeds. Once they splutter, add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger, garlic, and green chili. Sauté for another minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Mix in the cooked chana dal, salt, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

In a pressure cooker, add the rinsed dal and 2 cups of water. Cook for 15 minutes or until soft.
In a pan, heat oil over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add minced garlic, ginger, and green chilli. Sauté for another minute.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes are soft.
Add the cooked dal to the pan and mix well. Simmer for 5 minutes to blend flavors.

Drain and rinse the soaked kala chana.

Add ginger, garlic, and green chili, and sauté for another minute.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, coriander powder, and salt. Cook until the tomatoes are soft.
Add the cooked kala chana along with the water to the pan.
Simmer for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.

Add red curry paste and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add sliced carrots, bell pepper, zucchini, and broccoli. Stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add soy sauce and stir well.
Simmer for 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.

Hindi.name: थाई सब्जी करी
Hindi.description: एक जीवंत और सुगंधित थाई सब्जी करी, नारियल के दूध और ताजे सब्जियों के स्वाद से भरपूर, संतोषजनक लंच के लिए एकदम सही।

ingredients.name: नारियल का दूध
ingredients.description: क्रीमी बनावट और समृद्ध स्वाद प्रदान करता है।

ingredients.name: लाल करी पेस्ट
ingredients.description: प्रामाणिक थाई स्वाद और मसाला जोड़ता है।

ingredients.name: शिमला मिर्च
ingredients.description: क्रंच और जीवंत रंग जोड़ता है।

ingredients.name: जुकीनी
ingredients.description: हल्का स्वाद और बनावट जोड़ता है।

ingredients.name: तुलसी के पत्ते
ingredients.description: ताजा सुगंध और स्वाद जोड़ता है।

ingredients.name: जैतून का तेल
ingredients.description: सब्जियों को भूनने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।

cookingSteps: एक पैन में मध्यम आंच पर जैतून का तेल गर्म करें।
लाल करी पेस्ट डालें और 1-2 मिनट तक भूनें जब तक सुगंधित न हो जाए।
कटी हुई गाजर, शिमला मिर्च, जुकीनी, और ब्रोकली डालें। 5 मिनट तक भूनें।
नारियल का दूध डालें और उबालने के लिए लाएं।
सोया सॉस डालें और अच्छी तरह मिलाएं।
10 मिनट तक उबालें जब तक सब्जियाँ नरम न हो जाएं।
तुलसी के पत्ते और नींबू का रस डालें। मिलाएं और 2 मिनट और पकाएं।
गर्मागर्म एक कटोरे में परोसें।

Marathi.name: थाई भाज्या करी
Marathi.description: एक जीवंत आणि सुगंधित थाई भाज्या करी, नारळाच्या दूध आणि ताज्या भाज्या यांचे समृद्ध चव असलेली, संतोषजनक लंचसाठी परिपूर्ण.

ingredients.name: नारळाचे दूध
ingredients.description: क्रीमी टेक्चर आणि समृद्ध चव प्रदान करते.

ingredients.name: लाल करी पेस्ट
ingredients.description: प्रामाणिक थाई चव आणि मसाला वाढवते.

cookingSteps: एका पातेल्यात मध्यम आचेवर ऑलिव्ह ऑईल गरम करा.
लाल करी पेस्ट घाला आणि 1-2 मिनिटे पराठा करा जोपर्यंत सुगंधित होत नाही.
कापलेले गाजर, बेल पेपर, झुकीनी, आणि ब्रोकली घाला. 5 मिनिटे स्टर-फ्राय करा.
नारळाचे दूध ओता आणि उकळा.
सोया सॉस घाला आणि चांगले मिसळा.
भाज्या मऊ होईपर्यंत 10 मिनिटे उकळा.
तुलसीची पाने आणि लिंबाचा रस घाला. आणखी 2 मिनिटे शिजवा.
उष्णता मध्ये एका भांड्यात सर्व्ह करा.

oldName: Japanese Miso Vegetable Soup with Rice

ingredients.name: Tofu

Add sliced shiitake mushrooms, grated ginger, and minced garlic. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add diced carrot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in miso paste and soy sauce until dissolved.
Add cubed tofu and spinach, simmer for another 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped green onions before serving.

Hindi.name: जापानी मिसो सब्जी सूप
Hindi.description: एक पौष्टिक और स्वादिष्ट जापानी सूप जो मिसो पेस्ट और विभिन्न ताजे सब्जियों से बना है, हल्के लेकिन संतोषजनक दोपहर के भोजन के लिए बिल्कुल सही।

ingredients.name: मिसो पेस्ट
ingredients.description: उमामी स्वाद और प्रोबायोटिक्स में समृद्ध।

ingredients.name: टोफू
ingredients.description: प्रोटीन में उच्च और कैलोरी में कम।

ingredients.name: शिटाके मशरूम
ingredients.description: गहरा, मिट्टी जैसा स्वाद जोड़ता है।

ingredients.name: हरी प्याज
ingredients.description: ताजा, हल्का प्याज का स्वाद जोड़ता है।

ingredients.name: लहसुन
ingredients.description: तेज सुगंध के साथ स्वाद को बढ़ाता है।

cookingSteps: एक बर्तन में मध्यम आंच पर पानी गरम करें।
कटे हुए शिटाके मशरूम, कद्दूकस किया हुआ अदरक, और कटा हुआ लहसुन डालें। 5 मिनट तक उबालें।
कटी हुई गाजर डालें और नरम होने तक पकाएं, लगभग 5 मिनट।
मिसो पेस्ट और सोया सॉस डालें जब तक कि वह घुल न जाए।
क्यूब किए हुए टोफू और पालक डालें, और 5 मिनट तक और उबालें।
सेवा करने से पहले कटी हुई हरी प्याज से सजाएं।

Marathi.name: जपानी मिसो भाज्या सूप
Marathi.description: मिसो पेस्ट आणि विविध ताज्या भाज्या वापरून बनवलेला पोषणयुक्त आणि चवदार जपानी सूप, हलक्या पण समाधानकारक जेवणासाठी योग्य.

ingredients.name: मिसो पेस्ट
ingredients.description: उमामी चवीत समृद्ध आणि प्रॉबायोटिक्सने भरलेले.

cookingSteps: एका पातेल्यात मध्यम आचेवर पाणी गरम करा.
कापलेले शिटाके मशरूम, किसलेले आलं आणि चिरलेला लसूण घाला. 5 मिनिटे उकळा.
कापलेले गाजर घाला आणि मऊ होईपर्यंत शिजवा, सुमारे 5 मिनिटे.
मिसो पेस्ट आणि सोया सॉस घालून विरघळेपर्यंत ढवळा.
क्यूब केलेला टोफू आणि पालक घाला, आणखी 5 मिनिटे उकळा.
सर्व्ह करण्यापूर्वी चिरलेली कोथिंबीरने सजवा.

name: Vegetable Biryani

ingredients.name: Basmati Rice
ingredients.description: Long-grain rice known for its fragrance and fluffy texture.

ingredients.name: Carrot
ingredients.description: Rich in beta-carotene and adds sweetness.

ingredients.name: Green Peas
ingredients.description: High in fiber and protein, adds a pop of color.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Adds sweetness and depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.description: Enhances flavor with a pungent aroma.

ingredients.name: Coriander Leaves
ingredients.description: Fresh herb for garnish and flavor.

ingredients.name: Garam Masala
ingredients.description: A blend of spices for warmth and depth.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.description: Used for sautéing vegetables and spices.

instructions: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Soak it in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add sliced onions, ginger, garlic, and green chili. Sauté until onions are golden brown.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric powder, and salt. Cook until tomatoes are soft.
Add diced carrots, potatoes, and green peas. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in yogurt, garam masala, and half of the chopped cilantro and mint leaves.
Add the soaked rice and 200 ml of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until rice is cooked and water is absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork, garnish with remaining cilantro and mint leaves, and serve hot.

name: Methi Thepla

ingredients.name: Whole Wheat Flour
ingredients.description: Rich in fiber and essential nutrients.

ingredients.name: Fenugreek Leaves
ingredients.description: Adds a distinct flavor and is rich in iron.

ingredients.name: Cumin Seeds
ingredients.description: Enhances flavor with a warm, earthy taste.

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine whole wheat flour, fenugreek leaves, yogurt, turmeric powder, red chili powder, cumin seeds, and salt.
Add water gradually and knead into a soft dough. Add a little oil to make the dough smooth.
Divide the dough into equal portions and roll each portion into a ball.
Flatten each ball and roll it out into a thin circle using a rolling pin.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Place the rolled thepla on the pan.
Cook on both sides, applying a little oil, until golden brown spots appear.
Repeat with the remaining dough portions.
Serve hot.

oldName: Egg Salad with Whole Wheat Toast
name: Egg Salad

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.description: Rich in protein and essential nutrients.

instructions: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until hard-boiled. Cool them under cold water, peel, and chop.
Chop the celery and red onion finely.
In a bowl, combine chopped eggs, celery, and red onion.
Add mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, juice of half a lemon, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

oldName: Vegetable Soup with Whole Wheat Toast
name: Vegetable Soup

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.description: Enhances flavor with a pungent aroma.

instructions: Chop the carrot, celery, onion, garlic, tomato, green beans, and potato into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, sauté until translucent.
Add carrot, celery, and potato, cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes and green beans, cook for another 3 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

name: Idli

ingredients.name: Urad Dal
ingredients.description: Rich in protein and aids in fermentation.

instructions: Rinse the rice and urad dal separately under running water.
Soak the rice and urad dal in water for 4-6 hours. Add fenugreek seeds to the urad dal while soaking.
Drain the water and grind the urad dal and fenugreek seeds to a smooth batter, adding water as needed.
Grind the rice to a slightly coarse batter.
Mix both batters together, add salt, and let it ferment overnight or for 8-12 hours until it doubles in volume.
Grease idli molds and pour the batter into them.
Steam the idlis for 10-15 minutes until cooked through.
Serve hot.

Hindi.name: इडली
Hindi.description: इडली एक पारंपरिक दक्षिण भारतीय नाश्ता है जो किण्वित चावल और उरद दाल के बैटर से बनाया जाता है, जिसे भाप में fluffy परिपूर्णता तक पकाया जाता है।

ingredients.name: चावल
ingredients.description: कार्बोहाइड्रेट और ऊर्जा प्रदान करता है।

ingredients.name: उरद दाल
ingredients.description: प्रोटीन में समृद्ध है और किण्वन में मदद करता है।

ingredients.name: मेथी के बीज
ingredients.description: किण्वन को बढ़ाता है और स्वाद जोड़ता है।

ingredients.name: पानी
ingredients.description: बैटर बनाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।

cookingSteps: चावल और उरद दाल को अलग-अलग बहते पानी के नीचे धो लें।
चावल और उरद दाल को 4-6 घंटे के लिए पानी में भिगो दें। उरद दाल में भिगोते समय मेथी के बीज डालें।
पानी निकालें और उरद दाल और मेथी के बीजों को चिकना बैटर बनाने के लिए पीसें, आवश्यकतानुसार पानी डालें।
चावल को थोड़ा मोटा बैटर बनाने के लिए पीसें।
दोनों बैटर को मिलाएं, नमक डालें, और इसे रात भर या 8-12 घंटे के लिए किण्वित होने दें जब तक कि यह मात्रा में दोगुना न हो जाए।
इडली के सांचे को चिकना करें और उसमें बैटर डालें।
इडली को 10-15 मिनट तक भाप में पकाएं जब तक कि यह पूरी तरह से पक न जाए।
गर्म परोसें।

Marathi.name: इडली
Marathi.description: इडली ही दक्षिण भारतीय पारंपरिक नाश्त्याची डिश आहे, जी किण्वित तांदूळ आणि उडद डाळीच्या पीठापासून बनवली जाते, जी वाफवून मऊ आणि फुललेली होते.

ingredients.name: उडद डाळ
ingredients.description: प्रथिनात समृद्ध आणि किण्वनात मदत करते.

cookingSteps: तांदूळ आणि उडद डाळ वेगवेगळ्या पाण्याखाली धुवा.
तांदूळ आणि उडद डाळ 4-6 तास पाण्यात भिजवा. उडद डाळीमध्ये भिजवताना मेथी दाणे घाला.
पाणी गाळा आणि उडद डाळ आणि मेथी दाणे एकत्र करून मऊ पीठ बनवा, आवश्यकतेनुसार पाणी घाला.
तांदळाचे थोडेसे जाड पीठ बनवा.
दोन्ही पीठ एकत्र करा, मीठ घाला आणि रातभर किंवा 8-12 तास किण्वित होऊ द्या, जेणेकरून त्याचे प्रमाण दुप्पट होईल.
इडलीच्या मोल्डना तेल लावा आणि त्यात पीठ ओता.
इडली 10-15 मिनिटे वाफवा जोपर्यंत ते व्यवस्थित शिजत नाहीत.
गरमागरम सर्व्ह करा.

oldName: Onion Uttapa with Sambar and Chutney
name: Onion Uttapa

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.description: Used for cooking and adds flavor.

instructions: Soak rice and urad dal separately for 4-6 hours.
Grind the soaked rice and urad dal into a smooth batter, mix them together, and let it ferment overnight.
Chop the onion, green chilli, and coriander leaves finely.
Heat a non-stick pan and add a little oil.
Pour a ladleful of batter onto the pan and spread it into a circle.
Sprinkle chopped onions, green chilli, and coriander leaves on top.
Drizzle oil around the edges and cook until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip and cook the other side for a minute.
Serve hot.

Hindi.name: प्याज उत्तप
Hindi.description: प्याज उत्तप एक स्वादिष्ट दक्षिण भारतीय पैनकेक है जो किण्वित चावल और दाल के बैटर से बनाया जाता है, जिसे प्याज और मसालों के साथ शीर्ष पर रखा जाता है ताकि यह एक स्वादिष्ट रात के खाने का विकल्प बन सके।

ingredients.name: चावल
ingredients.description: कार्बोहाइड्रेट और ऊर्जा प्रदान करता है।

ingredients.name: तेल
ingredients.description: पकाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है और स्वाद जोड़ता है।

cookingSteps: चावल और उड़द दाल को अलग-अलग 4-6 घंटे के लिए भिगो दें।
भिगोए हुए चावल और उड़द दाल को एक चिकने बैटर में पीसें, उन्हें मिलाएं, और रातभर किण्वित होने के लिए छोड़ दें।
प्याज, हरी मिर्च, और धनिया पत्तों को बारीक काट लें।
एक नॉन-स्टिक पैन गरम करें और थोड़ा तेल डालें।
पैन में एक लड्डू बैटर डालें और इसे एक गोलाकार में फैलाएं।
ऊपर chopped प्याज, हरी मिर्च, और धनिया पत्ते छिड़कें।
किनारों के चारों ओर तेल डालें और नीचे सुनहरा भूरा होने तक पकाएं।
उलटें और दूसरी तरफ एक मिनट तक पकाएं।
गर्म परोसें।

Marathi.name: प्याज उत्तपा
Marathi.description: प्याज उत्तपा हा एक चविष्ट दक्षिण भारतीय पॅनकेक आहे जो किण्वित तांदूळ आणि डाळ यांच्या पिठाने बनवला जातो, ज्यावर प्याज आणि मसाले घालून स्वादिष्ट रात्रीच्या जेवणासाठी एक पर्याय म्हणून सादर केला जातो.

ingredients.name: तेल
ingredients.description: पाककृतीसाठी वापरले जाते आणि चव वाढवतो.

cookingSteps: तांदूळ आणि उडीद डाळ वेगवेगळ्या 4-6 तासांसाठी भिजवा.
भिजवलेला तांदूळ आणि उडीद डाळ एकत्र करून मऊ पिठात पीसा, त्यांना एकत्र करा आणि रात्रभर किण्वित होऊ द्या.
प्याज, हिरवी मिरची, आणि धनिया पान बारीक चिरा.
एक नॉन-स्टिक पॅन गरम करा आणि थोडे तेल घाला.
पॅनवर एक कडून पिठाचा चमचा ओता आणि त्याला वर्तुळात पसरवा.
त्यावर चिरलेला प्याज, हिरवी मिरची, आणि धनिया पान टाका.
कड्याभोवती तेल ओता आणि तळाशी सोनेरी तपकिरी होईपर्यंत शिजवा.
उलटून दुसऱ्या बाजूला एक मिनिट शिजवा.
गरमागरम सर्व्ह करा.

name: Ragi Idli

ingredients.name: Ragi flour
ingredients.description: Rich in calcium and fiber, ideal for healthy bones and digestion.

ingredients.name: Urad dal
ingredients.description: Provides protein and helps in fermentation.

ingredients.name: Fenugreek seeds
ingredients.description: Aids in fermentation and adds flavor.

ingredients.name: Baking soda
ingredients.description: Helps in making the idlis fluffy.

instructions: Rinse the urad dal and fenugreek seeds thoroughly and soak them in water for 4 hours.
Grind the soaked urad dal and fenugreek seeds into a smooth batter, adding water as needed.
In a large bowl, mix the ragi flour with the ground urad dal batter.
Add salt and mix well to form a smooth batter. Let it ferment overnight or for 8-10 hours.
Once fermented, add baking soda to the batter and mix gently.
Grease the idli molds and pour the batter into each mold.
Steam the idlis for 10-15 minutes until cooked through.
Remove the idlis from the molds and serve hot.

Hindi.name: रागी इडली
Hindi.description: रागी इडली एक पौष्टिक दक्षिण भारतीय व्यंजन है जो फिंगर मिलेट के आटे से बनाया जाता है, जो पारंपरिक इडली में एक स्वस्थ मोड़ देता है। यह एक संपूर्ण ब्रंच के लिए आदर्श है।

ingredients.name: रागी का आटा
ingredients.description: कैल्शियम और फाइबर से भरपूर, स्वस्थ हड्डियों और पाचन के लिए आदर्श।

ingredients.name: उड़द दाल
ingredients.description: प्रोटीन प्रदान करता है और किण्वन में मदद करता है।

ingredients.name: मेथी के बीज
ingredients.description: किण्वन में मदद करता है और स्वाद बढ़ाता है।

ingredients.name: पानी
ingredients.description: बेटर बनाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।

ingredients.name: बेकिंग सोडा
ingredients.description: इडली को फुलाने में मदद करता है।

cookingSteps: उड़द दाल और मेथी के बीजों को अच्छे से धोकर 4 घंटे के लिए पानी में भिगो दें।
भिगोई हुई उड़द दाल और मेथी के बीजों को चिकना बेटर बनाने के लिए पीसें, आवश्यकतानुसार पानी डालें।
एक बड़े कटोरे में, रागी का आटा और पिसी हुई उड़द दाल का बेटर मिलाएं।
नमक डालें और अच्छे से मिलाकर चिकना बेटर बनाएं। इसे रात भर या 8-10 घंटे के लिए किण्वित होने दें।
जब बेटर किण्वित हो जाए, तो उसमें बेकिंग सोडा डालें और धीरे से मिलाएं।
इडली के सांचे को चिकना करें और प्रत्येक सांचे में बेटर डालें।
इडली को 10-15 मिनट तक भाप में पकाएं जब तक कि वे अच्छी तरह से पक न जाएं।
इडली को सांचों से निकालें और गर्मागर्म परोसें।

Marathi.name: रागी इडली
Marathi.description: रागी इडली ही एक पौष्टिक दक्षिण भारतीय डिश आहे, जी फिंगर मिलेटच्या पीठाने बनवलेली आहे, पारंपरिक इडलीला एक आरोग्यदायी वळण देते. हे एक संपूर्ण ब्रंचसाठी परिपूर्ण आहे.

ingredients.name: रागी पीठ
ingredients.description: कॅल्शियम आणि फायबरमध्ये समृद्ध, आरोग्यदायी हाडे आणि पचनासाठी आदर्श.

ingredients.name: उरद डाळ
ingredients.description: प्रोटीन प्रदान करते आणि किण्वनात मदत करते.

ingredients.name: मेथी दाणे
ingredients.description: किण्वनात मदत करते आणि चव वाढवते.

cookingSteps: उरद डाळ आणि मेथी दाणे चांगले धुऊन 4 तास पाण्यात भिजवा.
भिजवलेली उरद डाळ आणि मेथी दाणे एकसारखे बॅटर बनवण्यासाठी पीसून, आवश्यकतेनुसार पाणी घाला.
एक मोठ्या भांड्यात, रागी पीठ आणि पिठी केलेली उरद डाळ एकत्र करा.
मीठ घाला आणि चांगले मिसळा जेणेकरून एकसारखे बॅटर तयार होईल. याला रात्रभर किंवा 8-10 तास किण्वित होऊ द्या.
किण्वित झाल्यावर, बॅटरमध्ये बेकिंग सोडा घाला आणि सौम्यपणे मिसळा.
इडली molds चांगले ग्रीस करा आणि प्रत्येक mold मध्ये बॅटर ओता.
इडल्या 10-15 मिनिटे वाफवून शिजवा.
इडल्या molds मधून काढा आणि गरमागरम सर्व्ह करा.

name: Ragi Dosa

ingredients.name: Ragi flour
ingredients.description: Rich in calcium and fiber, ideal for gluten-free diets.

ingredients.name: Yogurt
ingredients.description: Aids in fermentation and adds a slight tangy flavor.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.description: Used to adjust the batter consistency.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.description: Enhances the flavor of the dosa.

ingredients.name: Green Chilli
ingredients.description: Adds a mild heat to the dosa.

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine ragi flour, rice flour, and yogurt.
Add water gradually to form a smooth batter. The consistency should be similar to pancake batter.
Stir in salt, cumin seeds, finely chopped green chili, and coriander leaves.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with oil.
Pour a ladleful of batter onto the pan and spread it in a circular motion to form a thin dosa.
Drizzle a little oil around the edges and cook until the edges start to lift and the bottom turns golden brown.
Flip the dosa and cook for another minute.
Serve hot.

name: Rava Idli

ingredients.name: Semolina
ingredients.description: Provides carbohydrates and a light texture.

ingredients.name: Baking Soda
ingredients.description: Helps in making the idlis fluffy.

instructions: In a pan, heat oil and add mustard seeds. Once they splutter, add curry leaves, chopped green chili, and grated ginger. Sauté for a minute.
Add semolina to the pan and roast it lightly for 3-4 minutes until aromatic. Let it cool.
In a mixing bowl, combine the roasted semolina, yogurt, grated carrot, salt, and baking soda. Mix well to form a batter.
Grease idli molds with a little oil and pour the batter into each mold.
Steam the idlis in an idli steamer for about 10-12 minutes until cooked through.
Remove the idlis from the molds and serve hot.

oldName: Grilled Paneer Sandwich with Mint Chutney
name: Grilled Paneer Sandwich

ingredients.name: Paneer
ingredients.description: Rich in protein and calcium, paneer is a staple in Indian vegetarian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Bell Pepper
ingredients.description: Rich in vitamins A and C.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.description: Adds a mild heat and flavor.

instructions: Slice the paneer, tomato, capsicum, and onion thinly.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Layer the paneer, tomato, capsicum, and onion on the unbuttered side of one bread slice.
Sprinkle salt and black pepper over the vegetables.
Top with the second slice of bread, buttered side up.
Heat a grill pan over medium heat and place the sandwich on it.
Grill each side for 3-4 minutes until golden brown and the paneer is warmed through.
Remove from the pan, slice in half, and serve hot.
